tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — the warm cream ground every screen sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the selected segment that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, inactive segments and wells set into surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dashed 'upcoming' outlines and quiet borders (decorative, never the only signal).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and the -soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and dates on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Strong pills, the bottom nav, tooltips, the 'night' course card. Dark in light mode, cream in dark mode — always the opposite of surface.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text, icons and the mascot's pupils on coral, mustard, orange and lavender fills — dark in both themes.

tokens.name: night-accent
tokens.usage: Highlight text (eyebrows) on night.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Hero accent: header panels, the #1 rank, highlighted course cards. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and icon wells behind coral-ink.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text (lesson counts, alerts) on surface, surface-raised and coral-soft.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Hero accent: leaderboard panels, active state, progress fills. Text on it uses on-teal.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips and icon wells behind teal-ink; inactive segment on teal.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as text ('Active', success) on surface, surface-raised and teal-soft.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the #3 rank, rewards, stars and highlights. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: mustard-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted wells behind mustard-ink.

tokens.name: mustard-ink
tokens.usage: Mustard as text on surface, surface-raised and mustard-soft.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Course and progress headers, chart bars, the mascot's feet. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted stat tiles and chart tracks behind orange-ink.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text on surface, surface-raised and orange-soft.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Feature/promo cards, the active nav tab and the mascot's body. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: lavender-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted stat tiles behind lavender-ink.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Lavender as text on surface, surface-raised and lavender-soft.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Tears and sweat drops on the mascot only. Never text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 3px solid, 2px offset — at least 3:1 on every surface and accent fill.

styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a card title.
